   MEREDITH MCCALL ON BEHALF INTERVENORS WALTER AND DEBORAH

 MCCULLOUGH MOTION FOR DEADLINE EXTENSION OF INITIAL AND FINAL

                                             BRIEF

        COMES NOW Meredith McCall on behalf of Walter & Deborah McCullough, pro se

intervenors and files the following motion for good cause to extend the initial and final brief

deadline by one business day to the following proposed dates.

 June 19, 2026                                   Deadline for Initial Briefs
 5PM on June 22, 2026

 June 26, 2026                                   Deadline for Reply Briefs (with Proposed
 5PM on June 29, 2026                            Findings of Fact, Conclusions of Law, and
                                                 Orderings Paragraphs)




McCullough Motion for time extension 59475                                            Page 1 of 3
                                              I.     BACKGROUND

        SOAH Order No. 6 on April 20, 2026, set the procedural schedule and deadlines for Initial

and Final Briefs before all intervenors had filed to motions to intervene. With now over 6,000

filings on the interchange and over 800 parties (parties not inventors) there is an extraordinary

amount of information to review, transcripts to read, and exhibits to review. This hearing may well

be the largest hearing in the state’s history along with a voluminous evidence record.

        In addition, there is an on-going appeal at the PUC commission on June 18, 2026 for route

adequacy and oral arguments at the PUC commission occurring on June 17, 2026 for another 765

KV transmission project for 59029.

                                              II.   DISCUSSION

        An extension of one business day for preparation for initial and final briefs will allow for

more time in general, since the extension occurs over the weekend for all parties to prepare a well

written and documented initial brief. That extra time will be a benefit of the ALJs because briefs

will be of higher quality, more accurate citing of evidence and better crafted arguments. Again, for

the final reply brief and conclusion of law better-quality briefs will benefit the ALJs, if extra time

is granted.

        On other Permian Basin Reliability projects such as PUC 59315 Dinosaur to Longshore

which had a similar voluminous amount of evidence and extra day was granted for Initial and Final

briefs to complete this vital portion of these proceedings. This will benefit all parties, Applicants,

ALJS, and intervenors alike.




McCullough Motion for time extension 59475                                                  Page 2 of 3
                                       III.   PRAYER AND RELIEF

        This process has been a freight train (as one testified on day 4 hearing on merits). It’s

been difficult for everyone. I humbly ask the SOAH ALJs to extend the initial and final brief

deadline by one day to allow for extra time to produce a beautifully written and well documented

brief to ease the ALJ’s burden of reviewing these documents.




Respectfully submitted,


By: /s/ Meredith McCall

Meredith McCall on Behalf of Walter & Deborah McCullough

Telephone: (512) 965-8249

Email: mgmccall81@gmail.com
